scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,client,server -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint:fix -w client && npm run lint:fix -w server
scripts.lint:check: npm run build -w shared && npm run lint:check -w client && npm run lint:check -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run test:watch -w client" "npm run test:watch -w server"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w client && npm run test:coverage -w server
